name: copystate
description: Browser extension: copy the page you see as Markdown for an LLM, with every form field, its value and all dropdown options.
author: mrvnklm

scripts.test: node scripts/build.mjs && bun run fixtures && playwright test
scripts.package: node scripts/build.mjs && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist/artifacts --filename copystate-firefox-{version}.zip --overwrite-dest && cd dist/chrome && zip -qr ../artifacts/copystate-chrome-$npm_package_version.zip .
scripts.fixtures: bun build tests/fixtures/libs/vue-app.js tests/fixtures/libs/react-app.jsx --outdir tests/fixtures/libs/dist --minify --define process.env.NODE_ENV='"production"' --define __VUE_OPTIONS_API__=true --define __VUE_PROD_DEVTOOLS__=false --define __VUE_PROD_HYDRATION_MISMATCH_DETAILS__=false
scripts.submit:firefox: bun run package && sops exec-env config/secrets/amo.enc.env 'web-ext sign --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir dist/artifacts --channel listed --amo-metadata store/amo-metadata.json --approval-timeout 0'
